name: diagrams
description: Engineering illustrations as static PNG/SVG for reports, issue trackers and clients: architecture diagrams, step-by-step processes, status boards, roadmaps/gantt and incident write-up dashboards. A Python SVG kit with three themes (light, graphite, night), bundled IBM Plex fonts, a layout linter (overlapping labels, text outside boxes, arrows through boxes, tiny type at preview size) and a palette checker (WCAG contrast, colour-vision deficiency, greyscale).
